global_header.style: Fixed top-0 w-full z-50 transition-all duration-300
global_header.layout: Flex container, logo left, nav center, user/actions right
features: Notification bell with active dot indicator
User profile avatar with premium dropdown menu (Shadcn DropdownMenu)

auction_room.layout: Split screen or heavy overlay. Left/Background: Massive high-res property image carousel. Right/Sidebar: Live bidding console.

components.live_feed: Auto-scrolling list of bids with highlight on new entries. Socket.IO connection must trigger green/red flash animations.
components.current_price: Massive typography (text-5xl) with monospace numbers for tabular alignment, glowing text-shadow on updates.
components.bid_controls: Quick-bid buttons (+50k, +100k) and custom input. Glowing accent CTA button for 'Place Bid'.
components.status_indicators: Pulsing live dot (Red/Green) indicating connection status. Countdown timer with dramatic typography.

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (collapsible) + Main content area. Topbar with global search and breadcrumbs.

components.analytics_overview: Bento grid of KPIs (Total Sales, Active Auctions, Pending Approvals). Shadcn Charts for revenue trends.
components.data_tables: Dense, cardless tables with sticky headers. 1px borders. Actions column with dropdowns.
components.forms: Multi-step wizards for parcel/auction creation. Image upload zones with dashed borders and drag-drop support.
components.status_badges: Soft background, solid text (e.g., bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700) for statuses.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Lucide-react for all icons, maintaining a consistent 1.5 stroke width.
For the Live Auction Room, wrap the component in a dark mode provider to force the dark theme regardless of system settings.
Ensure WebSocket (Socket.IO) integration in the auction room updates the UI reactively without causing full page re-renders. Use Framer Motion for bid entry animations.
For the Admin Dashboard, utilize Shadcn UI components heavily (Tables, Dropdowns, Dialogs, Charts) but strip excessive card styling to maintain the clean 'Swiss' aesthetic.
Do NOT use placeholder text for images; rely exclusively on the URLs provided in this JSON.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements, especially bid buttons and admin actions.
